acceptanceCriteria: A test in script/dogfood-change_test.sh binds a change, reorders two same-count hunks (for example by a rebase that swaps their order), reuses the old ordinal plan, and shows today's result before the fix.

dogfood-change refuses a plan whose rows were written for a different hunk order with a named refusal, or binds rows to hunk identity (path and patch digest) rather than ordinal; the test passes after the fix.
body: DCW-V0-019 (PR #134, decision 0376) refuses a citation plan whose row count differs from the prepared map (stale-nine-of-ten, stale-ten-of-nine). Decision 0381 item 6 names the remaining gap: a plan written for an earlier hunk order that has the same number of rows still covers every hunk, so citations can attach to the wrong hunks without a refusal. Unreproduced; criterion 1 reproduces it. Split from V1-0173. Not a 1.0 blocker (decision 0381 item 6).
